item.title: One thing I keep thinking about with Meta VR Glasses is how much the experience changes when the hardware becomes so lig
item.dc:creator: Dilmerv
item.content:encoded:
One thing I keep thinking about with Meta VR Glasses is how much the experience changes when the hardware becomes so light!
It makes me want to rethink everything, from how we interact with UI to how we design entire games.

item.title: Meta VR Glasses could be one of the biggest opportunities for developers, and I genuinely encourage you to start buildin
item.dc:creator: Dilmerv
item.content:encoded:
Meta VR Glasses could be one of the biggest opportunities for developers, and I genuinely encourage you to start building for them TODAY!
Years ago, when I was developing for iOS, I learned how valuable it was to be among the first to embrace a new device or major platform feature.
That experience taught me something I’ve never forgotten: being early can open incredible doors.
There’s so much to explore, so many ideas waiting to be built, and the tools are already available. I can’t wait to see what this community creates! https://x.com/Dilmerv/status/2119316526876524557/video/1

item.title: Here’s a cool Unity tip for gaze + pinch UI! 👀
item.dc:creator: Dilmerv
item.content:encoded:
Here’s a cool Unity tip for gaze + pinch UI! 👀
With Meta ISDK, the key components are:
• EyeGaze + GazeConecaster • GazeInteractor (rig) • GazeInteractable + ConecastableCanvas • PointableCanvas + GraphicRaycaster • PointableCanvasModule (EventSystem)
💡 Easier setup? Right-click your World Space Canvas → Interaction SDK → Add Gaze Interaction to Canvas.
The wizard configures the required components for you! https://x.com/Dilmerv/status/2119195793881981396/video/1

item.title: Something I find really exciting about Meta VR Glasses is that developers don’t have to start from scratch!
item.dc:creator: Dilmerv
item.content:encoded:
Something I find really exciting about Meta VR Glasses is that developers don’t have to start from scratch!
Your existing Quest apps can be adapted using the same Meta Horizon OS and v207 SDKs.
Imagine all the new hands-first experiences we can build from what already exists!

item.title: One thing that still amazes me about Meta VR Glasses is how much technology we’ve managed to fit into such a small form
item.dc:creator: Dilmerv
item.content:encoded:
One thing that still amazes me about Meta VR Glasses is how much technology we’ve managed to fit into such a small form factor, with the rest packed into a sleek, compact, beautifully designed puck.
Around 100 grams 🤯, and an entire VR/MR experience right in front of your eyes!
Once you start running your own apps & games on them, you’ll be blown away by how light and powerful they are!
I honestly believe this is a huge step forward for VR/MR! 🕶️🚀 https://x.com/Dilmerv/status/2119086815366029414/video/1

item.title: Here’s a cool MRUK feature worth checking out and a huge time-saver when testing Mixed Reality experiences across a vari
item.dc:creator: Dilmerv
item.content:encoded:
Here’s a cool MRUK feature worth checking out and a huge time-saver when testing Mixed Reality experiences across a variety of rooms! 👇
Did you know MRUK has a Spatial Testing framework?
You can automatically run Unity tests across different room prefabs or JSON scenes using RunTestOnAllScenes().
I used this heavily during the development of my game, Fuse Balls, and it helped me catch placement issues early without having to manually test every room configuration! https://x.com/Dilmerv/status/2118131475501420989/video/1

Want to create pinch grab interactions in Unity? Check out the key in the HandGrabExamples scene!
A few things to try:

item.title: XR devs, here’s a great tip and a feature I’m using on my own MR games.👇
item.dc:creator: Dilmerv
item.content:encoded:
XR devs, here’s a great tip and a feature I’m using on my own MR games.👇
MRUK World Locking keeps virtual content aligned with the real world by adjusting tracking space to compensate for drift.
Why it matters for MR: - Reduces visible drift - Keeps objects aligned with real surfaces - No need to anchor every object
📌 This is enabled by default when adding MRUK to your Unity scene! https://x.com/Dilmerv/status/2116675356937556345/video/1
